title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Please guide if Sunni Muslims can offer Zuhr and Asr prayers together (as Shia Muslims do). Has Rasulallah (SAW) offered Zuhr and Asar prayer ever like this. If there is an example, please guide where it is quoted? 29307 views Q. I am living in Riyadh. I follow Hanafi Mazhab. Once i started Iqamat for Asar paryers & said it same manner like Azaan. One of a person stopped me and said you did in wrong way. Then he said Iqamat again and said all sayings one time. After prayers he said 'Did you never notice how iqamat is said in Masjid Harram Makkah". I tried to explain to him that in Hanafi Hazhab Iqamat is said in same way as Azaan but with addition of Qad-qama-tis-Salah (two times). He said its wrong. Kindly give me reference of some Haddis or any other proper reference based on which Hanafi rule for Iqama is built. 10606 views Q. Is Praying sunna muaakada sitting down useless? answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 158994 Country: India Title: Passing in front of Namazi Question: (1) How much is the minimum distance which one has to maintain while passing in front of a namazi in Masjid? (2) Can we use a handkerchief, gamchha etc as a sutra and pass in front of a namazi? Answer ID: 158994 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 731/655/L=6/1439) If the mosque is big i.e. sixty feet long, then it is allowed to pass in front of the namazi leaving two or three safs /rows and if the mosque is not big i.e. less than sixty feet long, then it is not lawful to pass in front of a namazi at all. And one should not pass in front of namazi using a handkerchief as a sutra . ومرور مار في الصحراء أو في مسجد كبير بموضع سجوده في الأصح أو بين يديه في مسجد صغير فإنه كبقعة واحدة مطلقاً، وقال الشامي: المسجد الصغير هو أقل من ستين ذراعا...... أي حيث أنه لم يجعل الفاصل فيه بقدر صفين مانعًا من الاقتداء تنزيلا له منزلة مكان واحد، بخلاف المسجد الكبير والصحراء فإنه لو جعل كذلك لزم الحرج على المارة، فاقتصر على موضع السجود’ هذا ما ظهر لي في تقرير هذا المحل . (در مختار مع الشامي: 2/ 398 الصلاة / باب ما يفسد الصلاة وما يكره فيها ط: زكريا) أصل السترة أنه مستحب ، والثانى أن السنة فيها الغرز ... (الفتاوى التاتار خانية: 2/ 286) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
